title: Grounds for Closing a Care Management Episode
content:
A Care Management episode ends in closed status, with a closure date and a closure reason.

## Grounds

An episode closes:

1. when the member graduates after the tier's graduation stable months;
2. when Maternal Care Management reaches the tier's closure period, in calendar days, after the pregnancy end date;
3. when the member declines or cannot be reached;
4. when a hold expires; or
5. when the membership ends.

An active episode may also close when the member opts out. A referral may close before outreach when the member is not eligible or the membership has ended.

## Effect on personal care hours

Closure ends every authorization of hours the same day. The hours authorized and not yet delivered lapse, and the lapse is posted on the closure date.

## From which status an episode may close

| Status before closure | Grounds that reach it |
|---|---|
| Referred | Not eligible; membership ended |
| Outreach | Member cannot be reached; member declines |
| Active | Graduation; opt-out; end of the maternal period; membership ended |
| On hold | Hold expired; membership ended |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An LTSS Service Coordination episode with 12.00 personal care hours authorized for the current week, of which 5.00 have been delivered, closes on a Wednesday because the membership ended. Every authorization of hours ends that Wednesday, and the 7.00 undelivered hours lapse with the Wednesday as their posting date.
